count.behavior: Filters the actual outer collection by serviceDescriptor.ServiceType == serviceType, counts ALL matching descriptors, and requires exactly one. This remains a full outer-collection traversal for each reached single-registration assertion.

distinctImplementationTypes.behavior: Builds a ServiceProvider for each invocation, filters actual descriptors by service type, obtains ImplementationType, instance.GetType(), or invokes the actual ImplementationFactory with that provider, then materializes and checks nonempty/distinct implementation Types.
distinctImplementationTypes.multiplicity: Allows several different implementation Types, rejects repeated implementation Types. It is not an exact expected-type-list assertion.
distinctImplementationTypes.order: Descriptor/factory processing follows collection order through Where/Select. Distinct-count comparison is set-like, but factory invocation order, side effects, and failures must not be silently reordered.
distinctImplementationTypes.frequency: Called once per reached outer descriptor whose service type is absent from the helper sequence, not once per distinct service type.
distinctImplementationTypes.fixtureTypes: IConfiguration and IWebHostEnvironment are explicitly supplied only to the outer collection in this file. Their branch cannot be assumed to be the single-registration branch merely because the fixture initially adds one each.

assertionSemantics.equality: Membership/dictionary/distinct use Type keys or Type values without an explicit alternate comparer; the count helper uses Type ==. No string-name, implementation-identity or reference-only substitution is justified.
assertionSemantics.preservation: No collection, assertion, message, cache, comparison, multiplicity or order was changed.

realRegistrationProducerEvidence.behavior: Real owner calls AddLogging, AddAntiforgery, TryAddSingleton/Scoped/Enumerable, query/persistence/cascading/TempData registrations, persistent state registration, metrics/tracing and form mapping. Optional configure is null in these tests and helper.

AddComponentsMetrics scans the real collection for IMeterFactory; only if absent calls AddMetrics, then TryAddSingleton<ComponentsMetrics>. AddComponentsTracing TryAdds ComponentsActivitySource. This directly opposes assuming each second registration repeats every metrics/options descriptor.

TryAddEnumerable registers IPersistentServiceRegistration using PersistentServiceRegistration<TService>; TryAddSingleton registers its collection. The owner calls it for ResourceCollectionProvider and AntiforgeryStateProvider, preserving distinct closed implementation Types rather than collapsing service-type multiplicity.

The real helpers request distinct ICascadingValueSupplier implementations with TryAddEnumerable; the form provider uses an actual factory and IFormValueMapper. No invented provider list or fixture was substituted.

The real producer calls AddDataProtection and requests options plus six named singleton service types. These registrations illustrate the transitive closure omitted by a mere count of owner call sites; the whole external closure was not reconstructed.
